quote:
In the zones
furthest from sources of propagules and/or dominated by invasive
species, planting native species of diﬀerent functional groups can be an
eﬀective strategy for accelerating the recovery of the structure and of
certain species of the TMCF, while in the zones adjacent to mature
forests, recovery of some structural characteristics can take place with
the simple exclusion of disturbance.

relationship.requirement: Passive recovery through disturbance exclusion is supported in zones adjacent to mature forest; distant propagule-source zones may need active planting.
relationship.note: Direction means nearer forest favours passive strategy selection, not fitted distance-response or hard limit.

context.practice_as_described: Passive forest restoration through excluding disturbance in former pastures of tropical montane cloud forest, Veracruz Mexico. Author inference from one21year comparison; regeneration and soil processes may still require later intervention. Distance observations remain context, not thresholds.
context.note: User-mandated T4 targeting gate passed. Qualitative regional siting evidence only; no numeric curve, global exclusion, implementation approval or effect extraction.
